{{Top|leg}}
The '''Anaxes War College System''' was a system for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] classification. It was established during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Republic Navy War College]] at [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] and subsequently used by the successive galactic governments.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
The Anaxes War College System replaced the classification system that had been used since the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. This system had become ineffective, because its largest classification was the 600 meter [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], while many [[Warship/Legends|warships]] were much longer.<ref name="TEGTW" />

Some disagreed with the use of Star Destroyer as a classification, feeling that it was an unfair recognition of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], who commonly used the term for their own ships. It was ultimately included and by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many warships not made by KDY were referred to as Star Destroyers.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Description==
According to this system, [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ship]]s were divided into seven main classifications.<ref name="TEGTW" />
*[[Corvette/Legends|Corvettes]]: Ships of roughly 100 - 200 meters length
**Example: [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]]
*[[Frigate/Legends|Frigates]]: Ships of roughly 200 - 400 meters length
**Example: [[Corona-class frigate|''Corona''-class frigate]], [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]
*[[Cruiser/Legends|Cruisers]]: Ships of roughly 400 - 600 meters length
**Example: [[Belarus-class medium cruiser|''Belarus''-class medium cruiser]], [[Broadside-class cruiser kdb-1|''Broadside''-class cruiser kdb-1]]
*[[Heavy cruiser/Legends|Heavy Cruisers]]: Ships of roughly 600 - 1000 meters length
**Example: [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]]
*[[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]: Ships of roughly 1000 - 2000 meters length
**Example: [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyer]]
*[[Battlecruiser/Legends|Battlecruisers]]: Ships of roughly 2000 - 5000 meters length (small battlecruiser models were classed as "[[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]]," to separate them from larger ships of the type, but few recognized this classification as a formal part of the system.)<ref name="TEGTW" />
**Example: [[Bulwark Mark III|''Bulwark''-class battle cruiser]], [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]]
*[[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaughts]]: All ships over 5000 meters length
**Example: [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]], [[Kor Chokk]] grand cruiser

An abbreviated version of the system was also created, with three classifications—[[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], cruiser, and [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Use of the system on individual designs==
Despite the limits on dimensions, the system could sometimes move ship designs up or down in classification, depending on their armament and intended role.

Examples:
*The [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]], which would fall into the Frigate classification with its length of just 350 meters. Due to its armament and role, however, it was moved up into the Cruiser category.
*The [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer]], a fleet carrier, was classified as a Star Destroyer due to its relatively light armament and focus on starfighter power, despite being 2200 meters long, the same length as the contemporary [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]].<ref name="JFPT7">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>
*The [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] was classified as a Dreadnought, due to its revolutionary [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. Packed into a 4845 meter superstructure, the design would otherwise have been comparable to a large battlecruiser.<ref name="TCW:IV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref><ref name="TEGTW" />
*The [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] was occasionally referred to as a Super Star Destroyer, due to it being designed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], who had used the term Star Destroyer for their warships before the establishment of the Anaxes War College System.
*The [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], which would fall into the Heavy Cruiser classification with its length of 900 meters, would be identified as a Star Destroyer due to its armament and role.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was definitely awesome to be able to use some ideas already approved for WARFARE...|Jason Fry, on details in his book ''The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles''|<ref name="TFNJF">{{WebCite|url=http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-clone-wars-incredible-vehicles-spoilers-inbound.31855959/page-2|text=''The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles'' thread where Jason Fry commented|work=the book and its usage of some of his ideas for the later ''Essential Guide''.|archivedate=20250404210244}}</ref>}}
This classification system was invented by author [[Jason Fry]] to help explain some of the contradictory systems used in Star Wars lore previously. He previewed some of the classifications in ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles'', a book released over six months prior to ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="TFNJF" /> Some of Ansel Hsiao's vessels, when they were included in the book, also had their ship classifications redone to take into account the system. Specifically, the ''Allegiance''-class Star Destroyer was reclassified as a battlecruiser, and the ''Bellator''-class Star Battlecruiser was reclassified as a dreadnought.
